content.text: The redline validates cleanly. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
input.rationale: Section 6.1 imposes an exclusive dealing obligation on us (the Company): for the entire term we may not participate in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products or the broad set of "substantially similar" products, and HDI gets the exclusive right to the "Deerskin" brand online. Because Section 4.1 renews the term automatically each year on 90 days' notice, and early termination by us triggers a Termination Payment under Section 4.2, this is effectively exclusive dealing for the full term with no performance-based exit — the walk-away position. HDI's reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 and the closeout carve-out in Section 6.2 benefit us and are left untouched. Given the reciprocal bargain and HDI's development/hosting investment, we took the fallback: exclusivity confined to Deerskin Products for a fixed 12 months, terminating automatically on HDI's failure to meet service levels, availability requirements or delivery dates (including the Section 1.6 launch date).

proposal.summary: Narrow Section 6.1 exclusivity binding the Company to Deerskin Products for 12 months, with automatic termination on HDI performance failure
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we should not be subject to an exclusivity or sole-source commitment, so we have narrowed Section 6.1 to Deerskin Products for a fixed twelve (12) month period rather than the full rolling term, and made it fall away automatically if HDI misses its service levels or delivery dates. HDI's reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 is unchanged.
